text: Original bilingual micro-scenes and original English explanations. Forty initial lessons and twenty longer continuation cases that deliberately revisit earlier scenes. No external prose or dictionary examples are copied.
localReference: src/data/cognates/spanish.ts supplies the app's existing word-family and caution conventions; reliability percentages are not reproduced or asserted for this course.

dictionaryChecks.use: Pregnancy and a separate uncomfortable/self-conscious sense. Teaching explicitly avoids an absolute never-embarrassed rule.
Cold/catarrh sense; regional caution in the lesson.
Help/serve and attendance contexts; no absolute one-word translation.

limits: Dictionary spot checks do not substitute for full instructor review. Word-family patterns are heuristic clues, not guaranteed translations or measured success rates. Master labels refer to course stages, not certified proficiency. Only Spanish target with English support is authored. No formal exam or offline lesson pack is added. HD audio is synthetic, not a human recording.
